Bedrijfsomschrijving

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - Saturday or weekdays
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

jobs.occupation: Global SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment
jobs.description:
The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

lobal SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment

 

Company Overview:

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Agfa Healthcare IT is a leading provider of advanced healthcare IT solutions, offering a range of software and services that help healthcare organizations improve clinical workflows, enhance patient care, and optimize operational efficiency. Their offerings include electronic health records (EHR), picture archiving and communication systems (PACS), radiology information systems (RIS), and other imaging and data management solutions. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and cloud computing, Agfa Healthcare IT empowers healthcare providers to streamline operations, improve decision-making, and achieve better outcomes. The company's solutions are designed to be scalable, interoperable, and user-friendly, supporting healthcare providers in navigating the evolving landscape of modern healthcare delivery.

 

Position Overview / Summary:
 
• As the Global SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment, you will be responsible for evaluating, designing, implementing, measuring, and continuously improving global order fulfillment processes. Working closely with business stakeholders and external IT partners, you will ensure that processes are effectively integrated into our global SAP landscape and support business transformation, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction. You will play a key role in optimizing end-to-end workflows, driving standardization and automation initiatives, and ensuring that our order fulfillment processes remain scalable, compliant, and efficient. This position reports to the Director of Operational Excellence & Analytics. 
 

Location: (location of position):
 
• Mortsel, Belgium. Hybrid working.  

What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

You will be responsible for:

1) Customer Operations Governance & Continuous Improvement:
 
• Designing and implementing streamlined future-state processes and standardized operating procedures. 
• Identifying opportunities for process improvement, simplification, automation, and standardization across the order fulfillment lifecycle. 
• Establishing, monitoring, and analysing key performance indicators (KPIs) and process metrics to measure operational performance and business value. 
• Ensuring processes comply with industry standards, regulatory requirements, internal controls, and risk management guidelines. 
• Driving operational excellence initiatives to increase efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. 
• Developing and enhancing operational reporting and process insights to support data-driven decision making. 
2) SAP tool ownership & Transformation: 
 
• Acting as the primary business owner for Order Fulfillment-related SAP processes and solutions. 
• Serving as the liaison between business teams, IT, and external consultants to align business requirements with standard and custom SAP functionality. 
• Leading global transformation initiatives, including e-invoicing deployment, SAP enhancements, and future S/4HANA migration projects. 
• Translating business requirements into system and process solutions. 
• Defining priorities for change requests, enhancements, and project initiatives. 
• Facilitating process analysis, solution design, and business decision making. 
• Coordinating testing activities and validating system changes before deployment. 
• Managing implementation activities and driving user adoption through effective change management. 
• Monitoring industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and assessing their relevance to Agfa HealthCare. 
 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

You will work closely with teams across Finance, Purchasing, IT, and other Business Process Management functions to ensure seamless end-to-end process execution.

This includes supporting initiatives such as Vendor Management, Customer contract management, Licensing Management.

 

Who You Are (Qualifications):
 
• Masters's degree in Business Administration or equivalent experience 
• Strong experience in business process management, operational excellence, or order fulfillment operations. 
• Advanced knowledge of SAP modules (SD, PS, MM) in SAP EEC environment 
• Familiarity with S/4 HANA is a plus 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills. 
• Strong communication skills in English 
• Process improvement & problem solving mindset 
• Proven ability to influence and drive change across functions without direct authority. 
• Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities in a global environment.

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The Role
 

As our Office Assistant, you are the organizational heart of our office. You keep things running smoothly behind the scenes, make sure colleagues and visitors feel welcome and appreciated, and give our team a helping hand wherever it's needed.
 

The tasks listed below give you a taste of what the job involves, but they are only one part of the package. As a growing scale-up, our needs change quickly, and this role grows along with them. Whenever something needs to be organized, followed up or simply picked up, you're the person who jumps in.
 

Reception and general office support
 
 

• Be the first point of contact for visitors and suppliers, phone calls. 

• Handle incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries. 

• Order office supplies, keep track of stock levels and make sure we never run out of the essentials. 

• Order laptops for new employees.  

Recruitment support
 
 

• Support in recruitment by screening resumes 

• Schedule and organize interviews (coordinate agendas, invite candidates, book rooms and welcome candidates on site). 

• Keep candidate administration up to date and help ensure every candidate has a positive experience with Zymofix.  

Accounting support:
 
 

• Support in purchasing, shipping and logistics (sent packages via DHL, provide necessary documentation,...) 

• Follow-up on goods purchased by staff: tickets, reimbursements,...  

Work clothes and office supplies:
 
 

• Follow up on the work clothes and personal protective equipment for our team: track needs and sizes, order on time and manage stock. 

• Keep the office stocked with supplies and act as a contact point for suppliers.  

Employee engagement:
 
 

• Organize the end-of-year Christmas gifts for the team, from choosing and ordering to wrapping and distributing. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You are very well organized: you’re able to keep an overview, plan ahead and you don’t lose track of deadlines or details. 

• You are a true all-rounder who genuinely enjoys supporting others.  

• You switch quickly and easily between different tasks and keep your cool when priorities shift. 

• You are open to taking on new tasks and like to grow along with a fast-growing company. 

• You are hands-on, proactive and spot what needs to be done before anyone asks. 

• You are a people person with a warm, welcoming attitude, both towards colleagues and visitors. 

• You handle confidential information, such as candidate data, with discretion. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• You work comfortably with standard office tools.

• Do you thrive on challenging supplier pricing and uncovering cost-saving opportunities?
• Are you equally comfortable with data analysis and commercial negotiations?
• Looking for a dynamic role in an international environment where no two days are the same?
Then this opportunity might be exactly what you're looking for.

As a Technical Buyer, you will play a crucial role in driving procurement performance across long-term projects. Your primary focus will be identifying and realizing savings opportunities while building strong, strategic relationships with suppliers. You will challenge cost increases, perform market analyses, develop compelling business cases, and negotiate optimal commercial conditions.

Our client is an international supply chain specialist serving the automotive industry. The company manages the procurement and distribution of fastening solutions and technical components for leading manufacturers worldwide.

This position combines analytical problem-solving with stakeholder management and requires someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and market conditions continuously evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze supplier price increase requests and assess their impact on procurement budgets.
• Conduct market research and benchmarking to validate pricing proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.
• Develop and present fact-based business cases to support negotiations and purchasing decisions.
• Lead commercial discussions with suppliers and negotiate the best possible pricing and contractual conditions.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing suppliers.
• Organize and participate in supplier performance reviews and business meetings.
• Monitor market trends and proactively identify risks and opportunities within the supply chain.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Manage purchasing activities for strategic, long-term projects from analysis through implementation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• 2 to 5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, procurement or a comparable commercial role.
• Proven experience in supplier negotiations and achieving measurable cost reductions.
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Commercially driven with the confidence to challenge suppliers and defend your position using facts and data.
• Experience within a technical, manufacturing or automotive-related environment is considered a strong advantage.
• Familiarity with procurement terminology, sourcing methodologies and supplier management processes.
• Fluency in English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

Production | Quality Control | Team Leadership | Rework | 5S | 3-Shift System

As a Production & Quality Team Leader, you will supervise a team of Operators and Inspectors. You organize the daily workload based on priorities, skills and available capacity, while ensuring that quality and production targets are achieved.

Your new company
You will join an operational manufacturing environment where quality, safety and efficiency are key. As a Production & Quality Team Leader, you supervise Operators and Inspectors and ensure that production, inspection and rework activities are performed according to the required quality and safety standards.

Your new role
 
Your responsibilities include:

• Supervising, coaching and motivating Operators and Inspectors
• Coordinating inspection, quality control and rework activities
• Performing first-off checks, line audits and spot checks
• Monitoring quality and ensuring non-conforming products are correctly identified
• Following up on production output, scrap and rework
• Training and supporting new team members
• Ensuring compliance with safety requirements, PPE and 5S standards
• Reporting and escalating quality, safety or operational issuesYou also ensure accurate shift reporting and maintain proper traceability of inspected and reworked products.
 

Your profile

• Experience in a production, manufacturing or quality control environment
• Experience in supervising or coaching employees is a strong asset
• Basic knowledge of quality standards and inspection processes
• Hands-on, communicative and well organized
• Able to work under pressure and adapt to changing priorities
• Strong focus on quality, safety and operational efficiency
• Fluent in Dutch and English
• Willing to work in a 3-shift rotation
• Valid driver's license and access to a car

Are you the passionate technician we're looking for to strengthen our team? Agristo, a market leader in the food industry, is looking for a preventive maintenance technician who is passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. As a technician, you play a crucial role in ensuring maximum uptime for our machinery.

Are you up to the challenge?

Then this job at Agristo, at our Wielsbeke site, is for you!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
As a maintenance technician, you're passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your objective? To ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
• Set an example by following the prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally friendly and orderly working environment. 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these observations accurately, enabling us to act proactively and minimise unscheduled downtime. 
• You carry out planned maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
• You will work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
• You will provide the necessary support and follow-up to external collaborators to ensure that their contribution is effective and efficient. In addition, you will mentor technical trainees and new employees to help them progress in their role. 
• You will keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo).
 
• You have technical training or equivalent experience. 
• You have several years' experience as a technician and a passion for technology. 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
• You have a proactive attitude. 
• You have logical thinking and good problem-solving skills, enabling you to work independently. 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and collective success. 
• You speak Dutch, French or English and are prepared to understand colleagues who speak other languages. 
• You are prepared to work in a 2-shift system.

As a logistics operator, you are responsible for monitoring and managing logistics processes, resolving malfunctions, performing technical interventions, and working with modern systems in an automated cold storage environment. You work in a two-shift system and have a technical affinity.

What will you be doing at Agristo?
As a logistics operator, you are responsible for:
 
• Monitoring and managing the processes within the logistics department to ensure continuity. 
• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility. 
• Interpreting data trends and reporting process information with the aim of contributing to improvement actions for the logistics department.
 
• You have a technical affinity. 
• You hold a valid forklift and reach truck certificate, or you are willing to obtain one. 
• Working in a colder environment doesn’t scare you, and you are not afraid of heights. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.). 
• You are comfortable working with computers and eager to learn new programs. 
• You work efficiently and with respect for safety and quality standards. 
• You have a good command of Dutch, French, or English.

At Agristo, you are the key player in the packaging process: from frozen fries to a perfectly packaged and palletized product. With your technical affinity and problem-solving abilities, you manage our packaging lines, coordinate the planning, and ensure a flawless process. Are you looking for a challenging role with responsibility, teamwork, and growth opportunities in a dynamic work environment? Join us and grow with a strong, ambitious family business!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
 
• Process Management: You are responsible for the entire packaging process, from frozen fries to a fully palletized and packaged product. 
• Operation and Adjustment: You provide first-line support for any issues on the line, make adjustments when necessary, and continuously expand your technical knowledge of our processes. 
• Planning & Coordination: You monitor and adjust the packaging schedule, coordinating its execution with the team leader to meet the planned goals. 
• Cleanliness and Hygiene: You ensure a clean and organized work environment by overseeing and coordinating cleaning tasks. 
• Material Management: You are responsible for the timely ordering and availability of necessary materials, such as film, cardboard, and spices. 
• Problem Solving: You proactively identify issues in the packaging process and take corrective actions to ensure continuity. 
• Administrative Support: You perform administrative tasks, such as reporting incidents and documenting process information. 
• Packaging Testing: You assist in and conduct packaging process tests in collaboration with Agristo colleagues. 
• Knowledge Sharing: You contribute to the development of instructions and training materials and support knowledge transfer within the team. 
• Employee Guidance: You mentor and support team members, helping them enhance their skills and knowledge.
With this diverse range of responsibilities, you are an essential link in ensuring a smooth and high-quality packaging process!
 
• You have solid experience as a packaging operator in the food industry or have already gained experience in a coordinating role. 
• You possess technical and process insight. 
• You have a problem-solving mindset, are not afraid to critically assess existing processes, and take initiative to implement improvements. 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English and are willing to communicate with colleagues who speak different languages.
